name: chatgpt-desktop-community
description: Community desktop client for ChatGPT and Codex, powered by the local codex app-server

scripts.package:mac: npm run build && electron-packager . "ChatGPT Desktop Community" --platform=darwin --arch=arm64 --out=release --overwrite --prune=true --asar --app-bundle-id=com.ninotquyi.chatgpt-desktop-community --ignore="^/(release|\\.git|\\.omx|_analysis)($|/)"
scripts.package:mac:universal: npm run build && electron-packager . "ChatGPT Desktop Community" --platform=darwin --arch=universal --out=release --overwrite --prune=true --asar --app-bundle-id=com.ninotquyi.chatgpt-desktop-community --ignore="^/(release|\\.git|\\.omx|_analysis)($|/)"
scripts.package:mac:x64: npm run build && electron-packager . "ChatGPT Desktop Community" --platform=darwin --arch=x64 --out=release --overwrite --prune=true --asar --app-bundle-id=com.ninotquyi.chatgpt-desktop-community --ignore="^/(release|\\.git|\\.omx|_analysis)($|/)"
scripts.package:win: npm run build && electron-packager . "ChatGPT Desktop Community" --platform=win32 --arch=x64 --out=release --overwrite --prune=true --asar --ignore="^/(release|\\.git|\\.omx|_analysis)($|/)"
